title: The Little Fox Who Saved a Star

scenes.text: One night, a little fox found a fallen star.
scenes.visual_prompt: A tiny orange fox finds a glowing star in a moonlit meadow.

scenes.text: The star whispered, I need to get home.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a warm golden star and curious fox.

scenes.text: The fox carried it through the glowing forest.
scenes.visual_prompt: Fox crossing a magical forest carrying a glowing star.

scenes.text: At the tallest hill, they reached for the sky.
scenes.visual_prompt: Fox on a hill beneath a vast night sky.

scenes.text: The star floated up and lit the whole valley.
scenes.visual_prompt: Golden star rising into the sky over a valley.

scenes.text: And the fox knew kindness can light the dark.
scenes.visual_prompt: Happy fox looking at the sparkling sky.
